rows.label: tlk70000077_02_msg0001
rows.name:
What do you think about relations
between Iira and Gula?

rows.label: tlk70000077_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Iira has advanced mechanical
technology, but its poor soil means it
can't grow many crops.

rows.label: tlk70000077_02_msg0003
rows.name:
And Gula can farm plenty from their
huge swaths of fertile land, but their
technology is one step behind.

rows.label: tlk70000077_02_msg0004
rows.name:
And we in Superbia want to build
friendly relations with both
countries.

rows.label: tlk70000077_02_msg0005
rows.name:
If Superbia can bridge the two, I
think all three countries can build a
good relationship.

rows.label: tlk70000077_02_msg0006
rows.name:
But when it comes to cooking, I guess
there'll be some hurdles that are
impossible to overcome. Hahaha!
